title: 第1章 美女你眼瞎第2章 十倍返还
content_zh:
天星大陆，南部，阴阳宗。
“恭喜落霞峰男弟子王冕，和落霞峰女弟子张秀牵手成功！”
台上，随着主持长老的一声吆喝，台下，众弟子爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。
这是阴阳宗一年一度的相亲大会，宗门会为适龄的单身男弟子和女弟子寻找合适的道侣，牵手成功更是可以得到十块灵石的报酬。
台上，韩风坐在男弟子席位上，看着自己身边的人一个个牵手成功，百无聊赖的打了个哈欠，把玩着昨天刚刚捡到的一个玉牌。
他只是一个种草药的杂役弟子，进入宗门五年了，至今没有打通灵脉修炼出灵气。
刚开始的时候，他很焦急，很努力，很勤奋，无比期待自己能够打通灵脉，踏上仙路。
渐渐的，他也就接受了自己是一个废人的事情，开始学会躺平，每天就打理自己的草药圃田，悠哉悠哉的享受生活。
努力不一定会成功，但躺平一定很轻松。
虽说再过一个月，就是他进宗门五年之期了，到时候要是再开不出灵脉，就得被赶下山去了。
但无所谓啊，在山下老家，他还有二亩地呢，可以接着种灵药，晒太阳，哪怕不能修炼，也能长命百岁，身体倍棒，享受田园生活，岁月静好。
至于选道侣这种事情，他可没指望谁能选上他，毕竟他只是一个没法修炼的废物而已。
阴阳宗的功法，都是讲究阴阳调和之法，男女双修，事半功倍，所以宗门特别操心弟子们的终身大事，每年都举办相亲大会。
只是对于韩风来说，双修什么的好麻烦啊，还得哄女孩子开心，送礼物送灵石送宝物，哪有种药草快乐啊，一个人自由自在的。
双修？狗都不要好吧？
忽然，韩风的脑袋被重重的拍了一下，额头直接磕在了手里的玉牌上。
吃痛的韩风扭过头来，怒视向了后面的人。
一张笑脸出现在了他的眼前，正是刚刚牵手成功的王冕。
“韩风，你爹我牵手成功了，马上就要能双修了，赶紧祝贺一下你爹。”
看着那一张贱兮兮的脸，韩风无语道，

“滚滚滚，好大儿赶紧去跟我儿媳妇双修吧，少在这里打扰你爹。”
“走啦。”
好基友王冕拉着满脸娇羞的张秀快乐的离开了。
韩风撇了撇嘴角扭过头来，然后忽然发现，
咦？我的玉牌怎么不见了？我昨天才捡的，那么大的一个玉牌牌呢？
韩风看了看手里，又看了看桌子底下，发现都没有。
应该是被好大儿偷走送给道侣献殷勤了吧？
韩风没有在意，继续看向了对面。
很快，单身男女们都一一选择了自己的心动嘉宾，牵手成功，台上只剩下了三个人。
被誉为落霞峰第一美女且拥有天灵根的姜酥柔，
被誉为落霞峰第一美男且出身显赫资质逆天的叶龙渊，
以及，
其貌不扬无法修炼的废人杂役韩风。
对面只剩下了姜酥柔一人，姜酥柔人名不副实，半点酥软温柔的气质都没有。
她螓首蛾眉，明眸皓齿，梳着精致的编发，身着一袭素色白裙，脚尖轻点着地面，端坐在椅子上，缥缈空灵宛如谪仙之资，整个人精致的像一件完美无瑕的艺术品。
那眼中的淡漠和和睥睨的高冷，薄薄的红唇微微上挑，配上完美无瑕的绝美容颜，非但没有破坏美感，反倒使得她的气质，更加的高贵，只可远观，不容亵渎。
在任何人的心中，姜酥柔和叶龙渊都是天生一对，而叶龙渊也确实追求了姜酥柔多年，只是姜酥柔一直没有答应罢了。
content_en:
Tianxing Continent, southern part, Yin Yang Sect.
"Congratulations to Wang Mian, the male disciple of Luoxia Peak, and Zhang Xiu, the female disciple of Luoxia Peak, for successfully joining hands!"
On the stage, following the shout from the presiding elder, the disciples below the stage burst into thunderous applause.
This is the annual blind date meeting of the Yin Yang Sect. The sect will look for suitable Taoist companions for single male and female disciples of the right age. If you succeed in joining hands, you will be rewarded with ten spiritual stones.
On the stage, Han Feng sat in the male disciple's seat, watching the people around him hold hands successfully one by one, yawning boredly, and playing with a jade token he just picked up yesterday.
He is just a handyman who grows herbal medicine. He has been in the sect for five years and has yet to open up his spiritual veins and cultivate spiritual energy.
At the beginning, he was very anxious, very hard-working, and very diligent. He was extremely looking forward to being able to open up his spiritual veins and embark on the path to immortality.
Gradually, he accepted that he was a useless person, and began to learn to lie down, take care of his herbal garden every day, and enjoy life leisurely.
Hard work may not necessarily lead to success, but it will definitely be easy to lie down.
Although in one month, it will be five years since he entered the sect. If he can't open his spiritual veins by then, he will have to be driven down the mountain.
But it doesn't matter. He still has two acres of land in his hometown at the foot of the mountain. He can continue to grow elixirs and bask in the sun. Even if he can't practice cultivation, he can live a long life, be in good health, enjoy rural life, and live in peace.
As for choosing a Taoist companion, he didn't expect anyone to choose him. After all, he was just a waste who couldn't practice.
The Yin Yang Sect's exercises all focus on the method of harmonizing yin and yang. Double cultivation of men and women can achieve twice the result with half the effort. Therefore, the sect is particularly concerned about the lifelong events of its disciples and holds a blind date meeting every year.
It's just that for Han Feng, dual cultivation and other things are very troublesome. He has to make girls happy and give gifts, spiritual stones and treasures. How can he be happy with herbs and be free alone.
Double cultivation? Don’t even want dogs, okay?
Suddenly, Han Feng's head was slapped hard, and his forehead hit the jade plaque in his hand.
Han Feng, who was in pain, turned his head and glared at the people behind him.
A smiling face appeared in front of him, it was Wang Mian who had just successfully held hands.
"Han Feng, your father and I have successfully held hands. He will be able to practice dual cultivation soon. I would like to congratulate your father quickly."
Looking at that mean face, Han Feng said speechlessly,
"Go, go, dear, hurry up and practice dual cultivation with my daughter-in-law. Don't disturb your father here."
"Let's go."
Good gay friend Wang Mian took the shy Zhang Xiu away happily.
Han Feng curled his lips and turned his head, and then suddenly discovered,
Huh? Why is my jade plaque missing? I just picked it up yesterday. Where is such a big jade sign?
Han Feng looked in his hands and then under the table and found that there was nothing there.
It must have been stolen by a good boy and given to a Taoist monk to show his courtesy, right?
Han Feng didn't pay attention and continued to look across.
Soon, the single men and women chose their favorite guests one by one, and successfully held hands, leaving only three people on the stage.
Jiang Surou, who is known as the most beautiful woman in Luoxia Peak and possesses Tianling roots,
Ye Longyuan, who is known as the most beautiful man in Luoxia Peak and has a distinguished background and unparalleled qualifications,
and,
Han Feng, a useless handyman who is ugly and unable to practice.
There was only Jiang Surou left on the opposite side. Jiang Surou did not live up to her name and had no soft and gentle temperament at all.
She has a furrowed eyebrow, bright eyes and white teeth, her hair is neatly braided, she is wearing a plain white dress, her toes tap lightly on the ground, she is sitting on a chair, ethereal and ethereal as if she were an immortal, and her whole body is as delicate as a flawless work of art.
The indifference and disdain in her eyes, her thin red lips slightly upward, and her flawless beauty not only did not destroy the beauty, but made her temperament even more noble, which could only be seen from a distance and could not be blasphemed.
In anyone's heart, ginger is gentleYe Longyuan and Ye Longyuan were both made for each other, and Ye Longyuan had indeed pursued Jiang Surou for many years, but Jiang Surou never agreed.
